children.value: > Fact From Story: The relentless nature of managing a club takes its toll and after what will be 12 years at Chelsea come the end of the season, Hayes, a single parent whose father died last month, decided that it was the right time for a change, professionally and personally.
> > Fact From Story: Hayes is a single parent whose father died last month.
> > > Fact From Story: After what will be 12 years at Chelsea come the end of the season, Hayes decided that it was the right time for a change, professionally and personally.
> > > Fact From Story: The relentless nature of managing a club takes its toll.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Managing a sports club is a stressful job.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People prioritize their family after the death of a parent.
> Fact From Story: Still, news of her decision came as a shock to her staff and players.

> > Fact From Story: Most of the other staff members found out with the players in the post-match meeting minutes before the official club statement, which Hayes had no hand in writing and did not even see before publication, was released at 3 p.m. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story: England and Chelsea captain Millie Bright was “devastated,” and most players were understandably sad | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People are not shocked by events they are prepared for. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People are often informed of important decisions before public announcements. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge: People often leave jobs for personal and professional reasons.
